d:
Vipakshi indiya gathbandhan ne ravivar, 1 navanbar ko 'vot bachao, desh bachao maha raili' nikali. is dauran vipakshi gathbandhan ke netaon ne ramlila maidan men pradhanmantri narendr modi aur mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar par nishana sadha.
Bijepi ne bhi 'loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao' nam se pradarshan kiya. dilli men bijepi ne 1984 ke sikh virodhi dangon ko lekar kangres ke khilaf march nikala.
Janie dilli men graund par maujud bibisi sanvaddataon ne kya-kya dekha?
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
